name: afterburner
description: Monitor and control MSI Afterburner via natural language.

functions.name: get_gpu_status
functions.description: Report current GPU status: temperature, clocks, utilization, power, fan speed and memory usage from MSI Afterburner.

functions.name: get_gpu_limits
functions.description: Show the supported tuning ranges (min/max power limit, core/memory clock offsets, fan speed) reported by Afterburner for this GPU.

functions.name: get_tuning_state
functions.description: Show the GPU's current tuning applied by Afterburner: power limit, core/memory clock offsets, voltage, and fan mode.

functions.name: get_profiles
functions.description: List Afterburner profiles by number with each slot's stored power, clock offsets, fan, voltage boost, thermal limit, and whether a VF curve is saved. Shows plugin nicknames when set. Optionally filter to one profile.

profile_id.description: Optional profile number (1-5) to show only that slot.

functions.name: show_configuration
functions.description: Summarize the detected Afterburner setup: interface status, version, profile count, and which controls are available on this hardware.

functions.name: get_tuning_ownership
functions.description: Explain who owns the GPU's tuning state: what Afterburner is currently applying (and whether a profile or startup auto-apply is active), noting that NVIDIA App / G-Assist tuning cannot be seen through Afterburner.

functions.name: load_profile
functions.description: Load an existing Afterburner profile by name or number, applying its stored settings through validated controls.

profile_id.description: Profile number (1-5), Afterburner name like Profile 1, or a plugin nickname.

functions.name: set_profile_nickname
functions.description: Save a plugin-local nickname for an Afterburner profile slot (for example 'quiet' or 'gaming') so later list and load commands can use that name. Does not change Afterburner. Pass an empty nickname to clear it.

profile_id.description: Profile number (1-5) or current nickname to rename.

nickname.description: Label to remember this slot by. Empty string clears the nickname.

functions.name: reset_tuning
functions.description: Reset GPU tuning back to default / stock settings reported by Afterburner.

functions.name: set_power_limit
functions.description: Set the GPU power limit as a percentage, clamped to the Afterburner-reported supported range. Requires confirmation.

percent.description: Target power limit percentage (within the reported min/max).

functions.name: set_core_offset
functions.description: Adjust the GPU core clock offset in MHz, clamped to the Afterburner-reported supported range. Requires confirmation.

offset_mhz.description: Core clock offset in MHz (within the reported min/max).

functions.name: set_memory_offset
functions.description: Adjust the GPU memory clock offset in MHz, clamped to the Afterburner-reported supported range. Requires confirmation.

offset_mhz.description: Memory clock offset in MHz (within the reported min/max).

functions.name: set_fan_percent
functions.description: Set a fixed GPU fan speed percentage, clamped to the Afterburner-reported supported range. Requires confirmation.

functions.name: set_fan_curve
functions.description: Set a custom fan curve as temperature/fan-percent points. Available only where Afterburner reports fan-curve support; otherwise returns a clear error. Requires confirmation.

points.description: Fan curve points, each { temp_c: number, fan_percent: number }, in ascending temperature order.

functions.name: optimize_quiet
functions.description: Make the GPU quieter by lowering the fan setpoint while keeping temperatures safe. Requires confirmation.

functions.name: optimize_thermal
functions.description: Keep the GPU below a target temperature (for example 70 C) by adjusting fan behavior. Requires confirmation.

functions.name: diagnose_performance
functions.description: Explain what is limiting GPU performance or why the clock is dropping, using live telemetry and evidence.
